IF013-01.cardText: WORLD NETWORK // ORIENTATIONFIRST UPLINKTHE JOBYou run the network from this desk. Every sector prints a Tax yield, but only a Nexus-held sector pays it: North America pays from the start, Europe does not. Keep sectors Nexus-held.START HEREFocus a sector and read its four numbers; Pause while you read. Start with NEON GARDEN in OSLO, the open contract with the highest Chance (87%).STRATEGIC TIMEPause and Clock speed control strategic time: Pause stops it while you read, 1x to 8x runs it faster. The clock is a resource: labs, healing, Tax and contract expiry all run on it.THE FOUR NUMBERSCONTROL: how much of the sector Nexus holds; a win raises it.UNREST: pressure against that hold; past the pressure line a crisis can break out.TAX YIELD: Credits per 24 strategic hours, paid only while Nexus-held.GARRISON CONDITION: SECURE, STRAINED or CRITICAL, read from Control.UNDERSTOOD
